summary: קִרְיָה is a city or settled town. Zion is called the city of the great King. The noun is kept under its own consonants, distinct from the verb קרה.

senses.definition: A settled city, here Zion as Yahweh's holy city.

note:
The noun קריה is kept separate from the unrelated verb קרה. Syriac ܩܪܝܐ supplies the city cognate.

Root (2026-11-21): Filed under the third-weak root קרה: קִרְיָה is qiry- with the feminine ־ָה, the same as Arabic قَرْيَةٌ 'town, village' under q-r-y (Lane p. 2988), and קֶרֶת (Pro 8:3, 9:3) is a shorter form. One spelling, one entry: the verbs קָרָה 'meet, befall' and 'lay beams' (Neh 2:8) share the key, though they mean something unrelated.
